# Legacy Rytm Projection Witnesses

These two software-only bank manifests were generated by source
`b613c7052fce08b8794a838af299a90e8ac7959e`, using the existing Show Bank
boundary harness and its canonical synthetic frames. Neither is physical
hardware evidence or user data. Both predate the Sample Bit capture addition.

`a4_only_v1.json` locks every Rytm pad. `scoped_rytm_v1.json` selects Pad2
Filter Frequency at depth0.25 / seed8. Both retain one legacy F1 A4 candidate.
The tests reconstruct their exact frames from shared fixture builders and the
canonical A4 renderer, then verify replay/import/recall without rewriting the
manifests or inferring a newer capture domain.
